name: ES-CL Pre-RTH vs RTH Correlation
description: Compares ES-CL rolling 30-bar correlation between pre-RTH (8:00-9:30 ET) and RTH (9:30-11:30 ET) sub-sessions on 5-min bars. Boxplot shows distribution comparison, regime bars show % time in each correlation regime per window, and summary table provides exact stats. Event markers tag breakdowns/surges with their sub-session.
source:
# ES-CL Pre-RTH vs RTH Correlation Comparison (5-Min Bars)
# Question: Is the pre-market open hour (8:00-9:30 ET) noisier than RTH (9:30-11:30)?
# 30-bar rolling window on 5-min bars (~2.5 hours of data)

# --- Data: ES (primary) and CL (reference) ---
es_raw = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
es = futures_continuation(
    timeframe=5Min,
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(es_raw.o, es_raw.h, es_raw.l, es_raw.c, es_raw.v, es_raw.oi, es_raw.s)

cl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='CL')()
cl = futures_continuation(
    timeframe=5Min,
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(cl_raw.o, cl_raw.h, cl_raw.l, cl_raw.c, cl_raw.v, cl_raw.oi, cl_raw.s)

# --- Returns (close-to-close on 5-min bars) ---
es_ret = returns(period=1)(es.c)
cl_ret = returns(period=1)(ffill(cl.c))

# --- Two Sub-Session Windows ---
# Pre-RTH: 8:00-9:30 ET (EU/US overlap before equity open)
pre_rth = session_window(
    session=Session(start='08:00', end='09:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(es.o, es.h, es.l, es.c)

# RTH: 9:30-11:30 ET (first two hours of equity regular trading)
rth = session_window(
    session=Session(start='09:30', end='11:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(es.o, es.h, es.l, es.c)

# --- Rolling Correlation (30-bar window on returns) ---
corr_raw = rolling_corr(window=30, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(es_ret, cl_ret)

# Session-end snapshots (one reading per day per window, with phantom guard)
corr_pre_rth = where(pre_rth.closed and pre_rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw), corr_raw)
corr_rth = where(rth.closed and rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw), corr_raw)

# --- Regime Classification per Window ---
# Pre-RTH regime flags (1.0 if in regime, NaN otherwise → Mean = fraction of time)
pre_high_pos = 1.0 if (pre_rth.closed and pre_rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw) and corr_raw > 0.5) else 0.0 if (pre_rth.closed and pre_rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw)) else corr_raw * 0.0
pre_low_pos = 1.0 if (pre_rth.closed and pre_rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw) and corr_raw > 0.0 and corr_raw <= 0.5) else 0.0 if (pre_rth.closed and pre_rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw)) else corr_raw * 0.0
pre_low_neg = 1.0 if (pre_rth.closed and pre_rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw) and corr_raw > -0.5 and corr_raw <= 0.0) else 0.0 if (pre_rth.closed and pre_rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw)) else corr_raw * 0.0
pre_high_neg = 1.0 if (pre_rth.closed and pre_rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw) and corr_raw <= -0.5) else 0.0 if (pre_rth.closed and pre_rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw)) else corr_raw * 0.0

# RTH regime flags
rth_high_pos = 1.0 if (rth.closed and rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw) and corr_raw > 0.5) else 0.0 if (rth.closed and rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw)) else corr_raw * 0.0
rth_low_pos = 1.0 if (rth.closed and rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw) and corr_raw > 0.0 and corr_raw <= 0.5) else 0.0 if (rth.closed and rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw)) else corr_raw * 0.0
rth_low_neg = 1.0 if (rth.closed and rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw) and corr_raw > -0.5 and corr_raw <= 0.0) else 0.0 if (rth.closed and rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw)) else corr_raw * 0.0
rth_high_neg = 1.0 if (rth.closed and rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw) and corr_raw <= -0.5) else 0.0 if (rth.closed and rth.opened and is_valid(corr_raw)) else corr_raw * 0.0

# --- Event Detection: Breakdowns and Surges with Sub-Session Tag ---
corr_lag = corr_raw >> 1

# Breakdown: correlation crosses below -0.3
is_breakdown_pre = crossunder()(corr_raw, -0.3) and pre_rth.active
is_breakdown_rth = crossunder()(corr_raw, -0.3) and rth.active

# Surge: correlation crosses above 0.7
is_surge_pre = (is_valid(corr_lag) and corr_lag <= 0.7 and corr_raw > 0.7) and pre_rth.active
is_surge_rth = (is_valid(corr_lag) and corr_lag <= 0.7 and corr_raw > 0.7) and rth.active

is_event = is_breakdown_pre or is_breakdown_rth or is_surge_pre or is_surge_rth
event_type = conditional_select(is_breakdown_pre or is_breakdown_rth, "Breakdown", "Surge")
event_window = conditional_select(
    is_breakdown_pre or is_surge_pre, "Pre-RTH",
    is_breakdown_rth or is_surge_rth, "RTH",
    "N/A"
)

# --- Output 1: Boxplot — Is Pre-RTH Noisier Than RTH? ---
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.variadic,
    title="Is Pre-RTH Noisier? Session-End Correlation Distributions",
    series_names=['Pre-RTH (8:00-9:30)', 'RTH (9:30-11:30)'],
    category="ES-CL Sub-Session Comparison",
    y_axis_label="Correlation",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Gray],
    show_data_labels=True,
    order=1
)(values=(corr_pre_rth, corr_rth))

# --- Output 2: Regime Breakdown — Where Does Each Window Spend Its Time? ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title="Regime Time Allocation: Pre-RTH vs RTH",
    category="ES-CL Sub-Session Comparison",
    y_axis_label="Fraction of Sessions",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='High +ve (>0.5)', color=Color.Emerald, stack='Pre-RTH'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Low +ve (0-0.5)', color=Color.Sky, stack='Pre-RTH'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Low -ve (-0.5-0)', color=Color.Orange, stack='Pre-RTH'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='High -ve (<-0.5)', color=Color.Red, stack='Pre-RTH'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='High +ve (>0.5)', color=Color.Emerald, stack='RTH'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Low +ve (0-0.5)', color=Color.Sky, stack='RTH'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Low -ve (-0.5-0)', color=Color.Orange, stack='RTH'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='High -ve (<-0.5)', color=Color.Red, stack='RTH')
    ]),
    stack_type=StackType.NormalStack,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="50%")
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(pre_high_pos, pre_low_pos, pre_low_neg, pre_high_neg, rth_high_pos, rth_low_pos, rth_low_neg, rth_high_neg))

# --- Output 3: Summary Stats Table ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category="ES-CL Sub-Session Comparison",
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Session-End Correlation Stats",
        row_size=3, col_size=2,
        row_headers=["Median", "Std Dev", "Obs Count"],
        col_headers=["Pre-RTH (8-9:30)", "RTH (9:30-11:30)"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(corr_pre_rth, corr_rth, corr_pre_rth, corr_rth, corr_pre_rth, corr_rth)

# --- Event Markers: Correlation Extremes Tagged by Sub-Session ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Correlation Extreme',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Type', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Window', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.SecondaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Correlation', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='ES Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(event_type, event_window, corr_raw, es.c, is_event)
